newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Macraes sees 97 production of 120-130,000.
newsitem.headline: Macraes sees 97 production of 120-130,000.

text.p: Macraes Mining Ltd said on Wednesday its unaudited pre tax operating profit for 1996/97 was approximately NZ$23 million.
It forecast gold production for the current 1997 year at 120,000-130,000 ounces of gold at an approximate cash cost of NZ$450 per ounce and a gold price receivable of NZ$685 per ounce.
Macraes was responding to an inquiry from the Australian Stock Exchange. Macraes share price has fallen to NZ$2.80 from $3.54 in late November.

"The 1996 forecast was production of 130,000 ounces at a cash cost of NZ$400 per ounce generating profits in a range from NZ$15 million to NZ$20 million before tax. The better than forecast production has resulted in a better than forecast operating profit before tax," the company said.
The full year audited results will be released on or about February 24.
